_comment: Hand-maintained manual data layer (PRD §4.2). Keyed by bare domain. Merged into dashboard-data.json at generation time by scripts/generate.mjs. Edit this file directly; do not edit dashboard-data.json. `blocked_note` is internal-only and never surfaced in the UI.

dmv.ny.gov.blocked_note: Online registration renewal flow: focus trap in the payment modal blocks keyboard users from completing the transaction. Automated scans pass because the modal markup is valid. Confirmed by Axe Auditor 2026-05.

on.ny.gov.blocked_note: Statewide URL shortener redirect page fails to announce destination to screen readers; scored 91 automated but functionally unusable for AT users.
